name: com.gpuvox/gpuvox
title: gpuvox
description: Find and rent GPU machines for AI (RTX 4090, RTX 5090, Strix Halo) by the hour, with live prices.

tools.name: search_gpus
tools.description: List GPU machines that are free to rent right now on gpuvox, cheapest first, with live prices in USD per hour for the whole machine. Use it to answer what a GPU costs to rent, or to pick a machine before renting. Prices include 40 GB of disk; billing is by the second and starting is free.

gpu.description: Part of the GPU name, case-insensitive: 4090, 5090, a6000, ada, pro 6000, halo.

min_gpu_memory_gb.description: Least GPU memory of the whole machine, in GB. A model needs its file size plus a few GB.

max_price_per_hour.description: Highest price in USD per hour.

gpu_count.description: Exact number of GPUs in the machine.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US, DE, PL.

limit.description: How many machines to return. Default 10.

tools.name: get_gpu_prices
tools.description: The current price of each GPU model on gpuvox: lowest and typical USD per GPU-hour, memory per GPU and how many machines are free. Use it to compare GPUs or to answer how much an RTX 4090 or RTX 5090 costs per hour.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Hourly history of one GPU model's rental price on gpuvox: lowest and typical USD per GPU-hour and machines free, oldest first. Use it to answer whether a GPU is getting cheaper.

gpu.description: GPU model or part of it, for example RTX 5090.

tools.name: get_machine
tools.description: Everything about one machine from search_gpus, by its id: specification, location, the hourly price for each disk size, and the data transfer rate. Read it right before renting: machines are taken by the minute.

id.description: The machine's id from search_gpus, for example m-12345.

tools.name: get_gpu_guide
tools.description: Reference facts for advising someone: which GPU fits which model size, what the software images contain, how a rental is billed, and speeds measured on gpuvox machines. Does not change with supply; call it once.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The person's account: email, prepaid credit left in USD, how many machines are running and what they cost per hour together, and the limits the person set for assistants (highest hourly price, machines at once, spend per day and what is left of it, automatic stop). Call it before renting to check there is credit for at least one hour and that the machine fits the limits.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.description: The account's rented machines, newest first, each with its status, SSH command when running, hourly price and what it was charged so far.

only_active.description: Only machines that are starting or running. Default false.

tools.name: get_rental
tools.description: One rented machine, brought up to date. After rent_machine, call this every 10 to 20 seconds until status is "running"; then ssh.command is how to log in as root. "failed" means it never started and nothing was charged.

id.description: The rental's id, for example r-0a1b2c3d4e.

tools.name: rent_machine
tools.description: Rent one machine now for the account behind the API key. THIS SPENDS THE PERSON'S MONEY: billing by the second from their prepaid credit starts when the machine is up and runs until stop_rental is called. Only call it when the person has asked for this machine and agreed to its hourly price. Starting takes two to five minutes and is free; poll get_rental for the SSH command. Always stop the machine when the work is done.

ssh_public_key.description: The person's SSH PUBLIC key (starts with ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa or ecdsa-sha2). Installed for root. Never a private key.

max_price_per_hour.description: The hourly price in USD the person agreed to. The machine is not rented if it costs more than this now.

image.description: Software the machine starts with. Default ubuntu.

disk_gb.description: Disk size in GB, part of the hourly price. Default 40.

stop_after_hours.description: The machine stops by itself this many hours after it comes up, and its disk is erased. Pass it whenever the person names a duration ("for two hours"). The person's own limit applies if it is shorter.

tools.name: stop_rental
tools.description: Stop a rented machine and end its billing. The machine's disk is erased and cannot be recovered, so copy results off it first. Use it when the work is done or the person asks.
